purpose: Planning-only parameter map for the A40 section methods. This file is not a runtime admission contract, execution permission, or owner decision.

authority.sourceBaseline: A40 docs/research/section-methods-v1/ and its cited code/handoffs
authority.reviewNote: Scoped technical endorsement is not owner approval, input readiness, execution or publication. The exact final packet review receipt is recorded separately in docs/handoffs/research-a41-method-configuration-closure.md; it is required before claiming final review closure.

sharedLifecycle.dimensionNote: Parameter classification describes what kind of parameter it is; the group-level businessReviewDisposition, ownerApproval, implementation, inputReadiness and execution fields remain separate. Classification values are not runtime closure or permission labels.

parameters.name: measureIdentity
parameters.type: literal source measure + sourceFamily + exact locator + valueState/value/unit/precision
parameters.candidateValue: Keep the source label verbatim; sales/search/reviews/co-occurrence are not renamed demand.
parameters.validation: Source locator resolves; value state and unit match source; retain period/timezone/universe/frame.
parameters.missingBehavior: No claim-eligible observation; retain an unlocated/missing inventory row only.

parameters.name: additiveAggregation
parameters.type: boolean plus exact aggregation unit/member refs
parameters.candidateValue: Sum only same measure/unit/period/timezone/universe/frame with explicit additivity and proven disjoint members/windows.
parameters.validation: Check disjointness and completeness; exact sum only; retain partial flag.
parameters.missingBehavior: Do not sum; keep located rows and emit AGGREGATION_OVERLAP_UNRESOLVED or ADDITIVITY_UNDECLARED.

parameters.name: demandProxyMapping
parameters.type: versioned mapping from literal measure/source family to interpretation/scope
parameters.candidateValue: No proxy mapping by default; no composite score.
parameters.requiredFor: Derived demand/proxy interpretation, not the canonical title, owner question, or attributed source wording
parameters.validation: Require named owner and approved revision; match source family, universe, period and unit.
parameters.missingBehavior: Keep literal measure output; block derived demand interpretation only.

parameters.name: denominator
parameters.type: explicit compatible numerator/denominator refs, unit and period
parameters.candidateValue: Rate only with same declared universe/unit/period and positive denominator.
parameters.validation: Denominator source and scope replay; zero yields null.
parameters.missingBehavior: No percentage; do not delay literal inventory.

parameters.name: sourceObjectClass
parameters.validation: Preserve literal wording and attribution; unaccepted taxonomy falls back to OTHER_LITERAL.

parameters.name: entityIdentity
parameters.candidateValue: Without a real stable key, report located records only.
parameters.requiredFor: Unique offer/product/vendor count or cross-source linkage
parameters.validation: No identifier minted from text; dedup only exact same digest+locator or real stable key.

parameters.name: quantityAggregation
parameters.candidateValue: Sum only compatible measured quantities with proven disjointness; no conversion, annualization or cross-object sum.
parameters.validation: Exact unit/period/universe and nonoverlap proof.

parameters.name: freshnessAndAvailability
parameters.type: source date meaning + reviewed freshness/status rule
parameters.candidateValue: Source-stated availability only; no default freshness threshold.
parameters.validation: Require exact date semantics and approved status rule.
parameters.missingBehavior: Keep attributed source statement; no current-supply claim.

parameters.name: peerSet
parameters.type: anchorRef + ordered peerRefs + membershipBasis + scope + revision
parameters.candidateValue: Owner-declared peers only; absent peer set yields unranked mention inventory.
parameters.validation: No AI/search co-occurrence peer selection; resolve only through real ID or approved alias.
parameters.missingBehavior: Inventory candidate references without labeling them competitors.

parameters.name: comparisonCompatibility
parameters.candidateValue: Side-by-side only for exact compatible definitions; otherwise separate cells.
parameters.validation: All declared scope dimensions match.

parameters.name: signedDifference
parameters.candidateValue: If specifically enabled, peerMinusAnchor = peerValue - anchorValue; no ratio by default.
parameters.validation: Same measure/unit/scope; retain exact value.

parameters.name: rankWeightScore
parameters.candidateValue: Disabled; no rank, weight, winner, best/worst or competitive score.
parameters.validation: Would require separate owner policy and review.

parameters.name: statementType
parameters.validation: Classify only with exact located statement; keep source claim and hypothesis separate.

parameters.name: dateAndEntity
parameters.candidateValue: Keep publication date and source-claimed event date separate; unknown stays null.
parameters.requiredFor: Dated event row or scoped link
parameters.validation: Date meaning and entity basis are source-backed.

parameters.name: driverHypothesis
parameters.candidateValue: Candidate hypothesis requires both mechanism and named affected metric; human review and layer-3 label.
parameters.validation: All references resolve; preserve counterevidence and assumptions.

parameters.name: riskImpactCausality
parameters.candidateValue: No probability, impact score, causal effect, risk rank or forecast.
parameters.validation: Requires separate reviewed method and compatible data.

parameters.name: dailySeriesAndSplits
parameters.candidateValue: Derive only an internal artifact key from exact row digests/locators and frozen series definition; not an entity ID.
parameters.validation: Reject duplicate dates and incompatible scopes; apply explicit gap policy to every declared split.

parameters.name: candidateGapRule
parameters.candidateValue: For the unapproved constant baseline candidate, REJECT_ANY_MISSING_OR_UNKNOWN_DAY_IN_TRAIN_OR_HOLDOUT; no imputation.
parameters.validation: Freeze rule before holdout; missing is not zero.

parameters.name: lastObservedDiagnostic
parameters.type: daily series + explicit trainEnd + later holdout H
parameters.candidateValue: anchor=y[T]; predict constant anchor for each h; MAE=sum(abs(pred-actual))/count(H), exact original unit.
parameters.requiredFor: Optional diagnostic evaluation after separate approval
parameters.validation: Observed anchor/actuals, nonoverlapping explicit holdout, no tuning; empty H is null.
parameters.missingBehavior: No score; do not fill gaps or threshold.

parameters.name: productionForecastPolicy
parameters.candidateValue: No real model, horizon, minimum history, selection threshold or production forecast is configured.
parameters.validation: Owner-approved exact policy and validated compatible history required.
parameters.missingBehavior: FORECAST_BLOCKED; keep gate and proposal distinct.

parameters.name: contextFields
parameters.candidateValue: Capture source-stated value only; states SOURCE_STATED, NOT_STATED, UNKNOWN, CONFLICTING, UNLOCATED.
parameters.validation: Exact EvidenceRecordRef locator; no inferred demographics/person identity.

parameters.name: actionAndAttribution
parameters.candidateValue: ATTEMPT_REPORTED/ACTION_REPORTED/COMPLETION_REPORTED/NO_ACTION_EXPLICIT/NOT_REPORTED/UNKNOWN; source-logged/self-reported/other-reported/unknown.
parameters.validation: Located explicit event or explicit no-action; preserve attribution.

parameters.name: attitudeCode
parameters.candidateValue: POSITIVE, NEGATIVE, MIXED, NEUTRAL, UNCLEAR, NOT_STATED; no star/silence inference.
parameters.validation: Explicit located statement with negation/context retained.

parameters.name: journeyOrder
parameters.type: exact A40 fields for same-record order; source key for cross-record link
parameters.candidateValue: Same record: SOURCE_EXPLICIT_SAME_RECORD + RECORD_LOCAL + SOURCE_STATED_ORDER. Cross-record only real source-issued episode/event key.
parameters.validation: Explicit same-record before/after or real source key/time; no fuzzy joins.

parameters.name: reasonFacetAndMulticode
parameters.candidateValue: PRICE_COST; ACCESS_AVAILABILITY; FIT_NEED; PRODUCT_ATTRIBUTE; INFORMATION_TRUST; OTHER_EXPLICIT; UNCLEAR. One code per explicit reason clause; preserve AFFIRMED/NEGATED/CONDITIONAL and SELF_STATED/OTHER_REPORTED/SOURCE_ATTRIBUTED/UNKNOWN.
parameters.validation: Require explicit choice-reason relation; clear literal mapping applies under reviewed codebook; ambiguity goes to adjudication.
parameters.missingBehavior: No reason inference; retain literal phrase or UNCLEAR.

parameters.name: barrierPair
parameters.candidateValue: Require explicit attempted task and explicit obstacle in one located record; use mapped barrier facets.
parameters.validation: Dissatisfaction alone does not pass the pair test.

parameters.name: unmetNeedPair
parameters.candidateValue: Both states and their gap relation must be in one exact located record.
parameters.validation: Two pointers and linking phrase resolve; source record identity is exact.

parameters.name: corpusAndCodebook
parameters.candidateValue: Source-native record or exact passage chosen before coding; open codes may be frozen in first-locator order.
parameters.requiredFor: I10 theme counts and I13 content coding
parameters.validation: Freeze membership/unit/revision; show exclusions, unreadable, uncoded and multicode units.
parameters.missingBehavior: Located inventory only; no coded count if units/codebook cannot be replayed.

parameters.name: withinCorpusRatio
parameters.candidateValue: Permit n/N only with frozen corpus membership/inclusion/unit/period/frame/codebook and complete denominator with coding dispositions complete; multi-code numerators may overlap.
parameters.validation: Label within this corpus; show excluded/unreadable/uncoded/multicode and pending coding. Pending suggestions do not become absent codes or silently change the denominator.
parameters.missingBehavior: Incomplete coding shows partial accepted-code counts and coverage, no final ratio. Unknown external selection forbids population/customer/sentiment-share/market-rate wording, not a complete corpus ratio.

parameters.name: populationInference
parameters.type: population frame + person unit + approved uncertainty method
parameters.candidateValue: Disabled without probability-relevant population design and separate review.
parameters.validation: Complete source-supported design and authorized uncertainty method.

parameters.name: brandPeerResolution
parameters.type: source-stated brand string + real ID or reviewed alias map; optional owner peer set
parameters.candidateValue: Unranked mention inventory unless owner declares peer membership.
parameters.validation: No identity from co-occurrence/text similarity; title remains canonical.
parameters.missingBehavior: Located mention only; no unique-brand count/rank.

parameters.name: groupDefinitionAndAssignment
parameters.candidateValue: Owner defines group meaning/overlap; assign only from source-supported value.
parameters.validation: Do not infer group from text/persona; label unassigned UNKNOWN.

parameters.name: denominatorUnit
parameters.type: LOCATED_RECORD, SOURCE_AGGREGATE or source-identified entity; measure/unit/period/frame
parameters.candidateValue: Numerator and denominator use the same explicit count unit; raw event counts are not distinct-record/entity rates.
parameters.validation: Check unit, scope, period, frame, inclusion and nonzero denominator.

parameters.name: sparseAndInference
parameters.candidateValue: No cutoff or estimator default. Exact cells remain internal descriptive material until release rule is reviewed; no inferential result by default.
parameters.validation: Policy fixed before inspecting values.
parameters.missingBehavior: Internal descriptive inventory only; no released sparse-cell or significance claim.

parameters.name: recordType
parameters.validation: Each type retains its own source locator and unit; no proxy substitution.

parameters.name: unitSubsetRate
parameters.candidateValue: V1 candidate only; exact key or source aggregate, same unit/window, one count per unit; numerator <= denominator.
parameters.validation: Reject count-unit mismatch or numerator > denominator; raw event ratios stay separate and are not conversion probability.
parameters.missingBehavior: No rate; retain separate presence/exposure/outcome records.

parameters.name: effectivenessAttribution
parameters.candidateValue: No causal effect, channel credit, ROI or ranking from touchpoint order/association.
parameters.validation: Separate reviewed design/result required.

parameters.name: mode
parameters.candidateValue: Design returns METHOD_ONLY/NOT_EXECUTED/null results; existing result requires exact retained protocol/data.
parameters.validation: Never infer execution from design text.

parameters.name: estimatorAndMissingRule
parameters.candidateValue: No default estimator or success threshold; compute only the method named in a reviewed existing protocol.
parameters.validation: Freeze before outcome review; missing is not zero.

parameters.name: newCollection
parameters.candidateValue: No new survey/interview/recruitment/experiment execution or simulated respondent prerequisite.
parameters.validation: Use existing records or an unexecuted design only.
parameters.missingBehavior: Out of scope; do not request collection.

parameters.name: ownerBrief
parameters.candidateValue: I01 stores owner text exactly; never infer the question or widen scope.
parameters.validation: Pin brief version; unset stays unset.
parameters.missingBehavior: M01 may show unranked inventory; no decision-oriented synthesis.

parameters.name: evidenceInventory
parameters.candidateValue: M01 downstream inventory; M11 unranked evidence groups; I14 unranked owner directions; unrelated sections optional.
parameters.validation: Exact ref replays; claims grouped only by question/owner labels or canonical section order.

parameters.name: ownerOptionsAndDecision
parameters.type: ownerOptions[] + constraints + separate authorized decision ref
parameters.candidateValue: I15 and M12 keep ownerOptions empty if none supplied; preferredOption/chosen null until human decision.
parameters.validation: No AI candidate promoted to owner option; button-only B7/B10 remain unchanged.

parameters.name: candidateTypeAndSection
parameters.validation: Schema can reject type/section mismatch.

parameters.name: exactClaimAndNumericBindings
parameters.type: exact claim refs + structured numeric bindings; for CODE_SUGGESTION also codebook ID/version/dimension/allowed code/exact record span/qualifiers
parameters.candidateValue: Closed schema checks exact refs/scope and numeric bindings; deterministic renderer inserts values. Code suggestions bind to frozen allowed codes and retain context/negation/condition/hearsay.
parameters.requiredFor: Candidate with cited evidence/numbers or code suggestion
parameters.validation: Pointer/integrity checks are not semantic truth; numeric binding must match verified value/unit/scope; invalid codebook or locator fails; ambiguity stays UNRESOLVED.
parameters.missingBehavior: Structurally invalid candidate stays untrusted; unadjudicated code never enters counts, n/N, groups or synthesis.

parameters.name: semanticReview
parameters.candidateValue: Free prose is untrusted; automated flags are warnings only; code suggestions require human adjudication; driver hypotheses require exact event/counterevidence, scope/entity/metric/mechanism.
parameters.validation: Human checks semantic support, invented constraints/IDs, attribution and action language. Driver candidates cannot claim causality, score, rank or forecast.
parameters.missingBehavior: HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED; do not promote; accepted codes remain interpretation, not source fact.

parameters.name: retentionAndDisposition
parameters.candidateValue: Retain exact attempt bytes; candidateStatus distinct from ACCEPTED/EDITED/REJECTED/DEFERRED/null human disposition; regeneration is a new attempt.
parameters.validation: Store user-facing rationale only, never hidden chain-of-thought; B7/B10 unchanged.
parameters.missingBehavior: No replayable AI attempt or human decision.
